content: VLA pipeline design pitfalls: (1) Perception-action alignment failure — 6/7 VLA models exhibit grasp-miss failures where approach trajectory misses target; (2) Action-scale mismatch causing overshoot/undershoot; (3) Rendering pipeline differences (LIBERO MuJoCo renderer vs Isaac RTX) cause distribution shift; (4) Cumulative error in long-horizon closed-loop control from autoregressive token generation; (5) Sim-to-real gap from physics inaccuracies in friction, contact; (6) Missing action chunking leads to jerky motion; (7) Treating fine-tuning as zero-shot — always need domain-specific demos for new robot embodiment.
